categories.ch-eu: Switzerland and EU operational sources, regulators, regional press
categories.active-breaking: Sources to monitor for in-the-wild exploitation and emergency advisories
categories.vulns: Vulnerability-focused: KEV, vendor advisories, exploit researchers
categories.vendor-psirt: Vendor product security incident response teams (machine-readable advisories)
categories.research: Vendor and independent threat research labs
categories.breaches: Breach disclosure trackers, victim filings, regulator notices
categories.ot-ics: Operational technology / industrial control systems specialists
categories.ransomware: Ransomware victim trackers and extortion-leak observatories
categories.sanctions: Sanctions designations relevant to cybercriminal infrastructure / state actors
categories.discovery: Use only to surface candidate stories; always trace to primary source

reliability_tiers.HIGH: Authoritative or with consistent editorial standards and original sourcing
reliability_tiers.MEDIUM: Generally reliable but may aggregate without verification or carry occasional errors
reliability_tiers.LOW: Discovery-only or known to require corroboration

statuses.candidate: Proposed by an earlier run; awaiting human review before activation
statuses.demoted: Lowered reliability or paused after consecutive failed fetches; awaiting human review

fetch_methods.webfetch: Default. Claude Code's WebFetch tool fetches with its routine User-Agent and a small AI summarisation pass. Works on most publishers.
fetch_methods.bridge: Use `python3 tools/fetch_source.py url <URL>` (browser User-Agent, no JS, no auth). Required for publishers that 403 the routine UA. Host MUST be on the bridge ALLOWED_HOSTS list.
fetch_methods.rss: Use the documented RSS/Atom URL — many sites are JS-rendered SPAs whose listing page is empty to WebFetch but whose feed is plain XML.
fetch_methods.api: Bridge fetcher subcommand for one of the structured endpoints (cisa-kev JSON, ncsc-csh dashboard / detail). Returns parsed JSON.
fetch_methods.blocked: Even the bridge gets 403 (Cloudflare / geo-IP / WAF). Surface as a coverage gap — do not retry.
